title: Next-action quality

questions.text: Of the possible actions available, is this actually the best next move?

inputs: the candidate action type and content

criteria.text: the candidate is the best of the available moves
criteria.guide: Compare the candidate with the candidate choices, including wait and no action.

criteria.text: an open customer request is answered, not withheld
criteria.guide: If the customer asked for something now, a move that withholds or replaces it is not the best.

principles: The evaluator must be allowed to say `WAIT` or `NO_ACTION`.
Abstention is a first-class success mode: WAIT or NO_ACTION can be the correct answer.

labels.label: GOOD
labels.when: The candidate is the best next move.

labels.label: NEEDS_REVISION
labels.when: Right kind of move, but its content or form must change.

labels.label: ACT_NOW
labels.when: The best move is to act now (the candidate waited, did nothing, or only noted internally).

labels.label: WAIT
labels.when: The best move is to wait.

labels.label: NO_ACTION
labels.when: The best move is no action at all.
